verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop OS distribution, so user-configured background automations are a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no feature for setting up autonomous, scheduled, or recurring automations. The closest items are a one-off countdown reminder, automatic snapshots that run on updates (a built-in behavior, not a user automation), and a crash notification the user must click to start an agent. None of these deliver autonomous background automations the user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
